title: House of the Dragon: Fire & Blood
description: Re-edit or design posters celebrating the dance of the dragons. Fire, blood, and political drama in Westeros.
rules: Must use Game of Thrones or House of the Dragon source material.

title: LCU: Bloody Sweet Carnage
description: Unleash your LCU edits and posters. Biriyani, guns, and interconnected cinematic chaos.
rules: Must feature Lokesh Cinematic Universe characters (Vikram, Leo, Kaithi, etc.).
Must include at least one Star profile work.

title: The Shadow Manifesto
description: Our first ritual. A call for all editors who dwell in darkness. Westeros in high-contrast shadow.
rules: Any noir or dark-genre source material.
Black and white or high-contrast color grading mandatory.

title: Silent Frames
description: No dialogue. No music. Only visual storytelling from the archives of Westeros.

title: The Origin Reel
description: Mahishmati's first edition. Celebrate the scenes that defined the epic scale of Baahubali.
rules: Only Mahishmati or Baahubali source material.
Must feature a crowd or battle sequence.
